The findings suggest that regimented resistance training causes the body to become more efficient at using available amino acids for lean tissue synthesis, thereby mitigating the need for higher protein intakes. Alternatively, hard-training bodybuilders, particularly those performing high-volume resistance training routines, seem to benefit from consuming protein at the upper end of current recommendations; given the limited research on this population, it is conceivable that requirements may even be slightly higher than those reported in the literature (1 15).
